name: atem-agentic-os
description: Session handoff layer for AI coding agents — claude-code, codex, cursor, opencode, omp, and human sessions sharing one continuity contract.

scripts.update-mermaid: curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11/dist/mermaid.min.js -o src/web/vendor/mermaid.min.js && node -e "const s=require('fs').statSync('src/web/vendor/mermaid.min.js').size; if(s<1000000){throw new Error('mermaid bundle too small ('+s+' bytes) — download likely failed')} console.log('mermaid updated:', (s/1048576).toFixed(1)+'MB')"
